slides.headline: 6 SERVICES TESLA'S GLOBAL DRIVERLESS CARS WILL REPLACE FOR FREE

caption:
Tesla Robotaxi just launched in 6 new countries. The zero-driver era hit your market. 🚗

UK, Australia, Germany, Italy, Sweden, Singapore. App Store and Google Play. In the US, Robotaxi runs $27 vs $33 Uber. Your transport budget just got a cheaper competitor in 6 new markets.

Five moves:

1) Pull your team's rides in those markets. The $6 gap times annual trip volume is your savings number. Write it before your CFO asks.

2) Call your transfer vendor before any contract renews. Put $27 on the table. That rate exists. Use it.

3) One sentence in your travel policy: Robotaxi is the default in available markets. No new tech, no new hire.

4) No new multi-year logistics contracts in those 6 countries until Tesla announces commercial fleet pricing. Don't lock in now.

5) One board slide: current transport budget, 6 live markets, savings at $27/ride. A number beats a proposal every time.

SAVE THIS: the Zero-Driver Window, 5 moves, 6 markets.

Six new countries in one announcement signals Tesla's commercial timeline is moving faster than most boards have modeled. The executives who run this math this week are the ones presenting a line-item reduction next quarter, not next year.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: Tesla

#Tesla #Robotaxi #BusinessStrategy #CEOPlaybook #FutureOfWork
pinned_comment: Which move does your CFO not know about yet? Number 4 is the one most teams only notice after they've already signed a 3-year deal.

hook_sharpen.why: Candidate [1] hits instantly with a specific, concrete claim that makes you think "wait, really?" (6 services replaced FREE), while [0] hides behind cryptic language ("zero-driver window" means nothing to a stranger) that sounds polished but doesn't compel action.

editor_override: TRUTH VIOLATION IN HOOK — 'FOR FREE' is factually false. The caption itself states Robotaxi costs $27/ride. Calling a $27 ride 'free' is a fabricated claim, not a compressed one.
